description:
Get full details for an SRA accession indexed by NCBI: run (SRR/ERR/DRR — instrument, spots, bases, size), experiment (SRX/ERX/DRX — library design), study (SRP/ERP/DRP — experiment list), or sample (SRS/ERS/DRS). NCBI SRA indexes NCBI, European (ENA), and DDBJ submissions alike, so accessions returned by sra_search resolve here regardless of prefix.

Chain from geo_get (sra field) or sra_search (experiment_accession / first_run_accession).

accession.description: SRA accession: run (SRR/ERR/DRR), experiment (SRX/ERX/DRX), study (SRP/ERP/DRP), or sample (SRS/ERS/DRS), e.g. SRR14432476

name: sra_get
